mapper.select: SELECT credential_id, merchant_id, credential_type, secret_hash, secret_hint, status, created_at, rotated_at, revoked_at FROM merchant_credential WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_credential (credential_id, merchant_id, credential_type, secret_hash, secret_hint, status, created_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{merchantId}, #{credentialType}, #{secretHash}, #{secretHint}, 'ACTIVE', #{now})
